registration.title: More weight on line-ups, a goalkeeper line, or better predicted XIs
registration.what: Changing the weights on the predicted line-up's lines, adding a goalkeeper line, or investing in predicting the XI more accurately.
registration.why: Line-ups were a recent addition and their weights had not been checked on held-out matches.
registration.how: The same fixtures are scored with no line-up, the predicted line-up and the actual line-up, and the goalkeeper weight is chosen on 2023/24.
registration.hypothesis: Line-up information is worth more than the model takes from it.

events.label: Predicted line-up against none
events.meaningful: The existing line-up input clears 0.002 against nothing at all, which supports keeping it.

events.label: Actual line-up against the predicted one (the most a perfect prediction could add)
events.meaningful: No. A perfect XI adds a quarter of the bar, so better XI prediction is not worth chasing. Validation chose a goalkeeper weight of zero.

events.reason: Keep the line-up weights and no goalkeeper line. The line-up-specific gain (0.0013) and the perfect-XI ceiling (0.0005) are both under 0.002.
